read.speaker: Sealed Inscription
read.text: The runes here are still faintly warm to the touch: "I, Karneth, sealed this vault with my own hands and will not leave it — not in death, not after. What sleeps at its heart must never wake."
read.text_zh: 這裡的符文摸起來仍帶著微弱的溫度：「吾，卡奈斯，親手封印此地，此生此死皆不離去。沉眠於此核心之物，絕不可甦醒。」

cont.speaker: Sealed Inscription
cont.text: You get the distinct feeling that whatever wrote this is still keeping that promise, somewhere below.
cont.text_zh: 你有種強烈的預感——寫下這段話的存在，此刻仍在更深之處信守著這個誓言。
